title: mi_http Module
content_markdown: This module provides a HTTP transport layer implementation for OpenSIPS's Management Interface.
overview: This module provides a HTTP transport layer implementation for OpenSIPS's Management Interface.

dependencies_required.name: httpd
dependencies_required.reason: must be loaded before this module

exported_parameters.name: root
exported_parameters.description: Specifies the root path for HTTP requests: http://[opensips_IP]:[opensips_httpd_port]/[root]

exported_parameters.name: trace_destination
exported_parameters.description: Trace destination as defined in the tracing module. Currently the only tracing module is **proto_hep**. This is where traced mi messages will go.
exported_parameters.notes: WARNING: A tracing module must be loaded in order for this parameter to work. (for example **proto_hep**).

exported_parameters.name: trace_bwlist
exported_parameters.description: Filter traced mi commands based on a blacklist or a whitelist. **trace_destination** must be defined for this parameter to have any purpose. Whitelists can be defined using 'w' or 'W', blacklists using 'b' or 'B'. The type is separate by the actual blacklist by ':'. The mi commands in the list must be separated by ','.
exported_parameters.example_code:
...
## blacklist ps and which mi commands
## all the other commands shall be traced
modparam("mi_http", "trace_bwlist", "b: ps, which")
...
## allow only sip_trace mi command
## all the other commands will not be traced
modparam("mi_http", "trace_bwlist", "w: sip_trace")
...
exported_parameters.notes: WARNING: One can't define both a whitelist and a blacklist. Only one of them is allowed. Defining the parameter a second time will just overwrite the first one. WARNING: A tracing module must be loaded in order for this parameter to work. (for example **proto_hep)**.

configuration_examples.title: Example 1.4. JSON-RPC request
configuration_examples.description: This is an example showing the JSON-RPC request and reply over HTTP for the “ps” MI command.
configuration_examples.code:
POST /mi HTTP/1.1
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json
Host: example.net

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"ps","id":10}

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Length: 317
Content-Type: application/json
Date: Fri, 01 Nov 2013 12:00:00 GMT

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"Processes":\[{"ID":0,"PID":9467,"Type":"attendant"},{"ID":1,"PID":9468,"Type":"HTTPD127.0.0.1:8008"},{"ID":3,"PID":9470,"Type":"time\_keeper"},{"ID":4,"PID":9471,"Type":"timer"},{"ID":5,"PID":9472,"Type":"SIPreceiverudp:127.0.0.1:5060"},{"ID":7,"PID":9483,"Type":"Timerhandler"},\]},"id":10}

Host: example.net
